results.explanation: Post-Matric Scholarship provides financial assistance to SC students pursuing postgraduate studies. With your SC category certificate, family income of Rs 3 lakh (below the Rs 2.5 lakh ceiling for SC), and enrollment in a postgraduate program, you are eligible. The scholarship covers maintenance allowance, tuition fee reimbursement, book allowance, and additional allowances. Minimum 75% attendance required.
results.how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarship Portal) or state portal
results.source_quote: The Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to students belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and Minority communities for pursuing studies at post-matriculation level.
